title: Soul Snack #53: Is Painful Karma From a Good Deed Possible?
excerpt: Learn how to connect with your intuition every day.
bodyHtml:
Learn how to connect with your intuition every day. Click here to start your journey to authentic power!

An unprecedented new consciousness is reshaping humanity, and with it comes a deeper understanding of karma. In this Soul Snack, Gary Zukav answers a profound question:

If you act with the intention of love but accidentally cause harm, will you still create painful karma?

Gary explains that karma is precise, accurate, and always aligned with the intention behind your actions. Painful karma arises not from accidents but from the fear-based energy that fuels unconscious deeds. If love is the true source of your action, then what returns to you will be constructive and beneficial, regardless of unintended consequences.

The key is awareness of intention. Every word and deed carries the energy of either love or fear, and that energy shapes your experiences. When you choose love consciously, you create authentic power and a life of growth and compassion.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Snack:

  • (00:22) — What Karma Really Reflects
    Why karma is less about consequences of accidents and more about the intention behind every action.
  • (01:12) — The Role of Intention in Karma
    How the quality of consciousness—love or fear—determines what you experience.
  • (03:09) — Everyday Examples of Intention
    Why even something as ordinary as driving reflects whether you are living with gratitude or fear.
  • (04:00) — Karma as a Spiritual Delivery System
    How life returns to you the same intention you send out, teaching you exactly what you need for growth.
  • (05:34) — Becoming Conscious Creators
    Why awareness of your intentions allows you to shape your life and create authentic power.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

This week, pause and reflect on your daily actions. Ask yourself: What intention is fueling my words and deeds right now—love or fear? Consider moments when you may have caused unintended harm. Instead of fearing painful karma, explore the consciousness behind your choices. Notice how consciously choosing love shifts the energy you send into the world, and how it transforms what you receive in return.
